lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: report cold food, a missing item, or a long delay respectfully
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: One meal never arrived and the others are finished; ask for a fair solution.
lessons.title: Resolve a Missing Lunch Order
lessons.objective: Report a missing main course or cold dish, explain the delay, and ask respectfully for a workable resolution.
lessons.focus: Use il manque, n’est pas arrivé, il est froid, cela fait longtemps and retirer de l’addition to describe the problem and negotiate the bill.
lessons.scene: At a bistro, everyone else has finished while Maya is still waiting for her main course.

cards.en: I have been waiting a long time.

cards.fr: Pouvez-vous retirer ce plat de l’addition ?
cards.en: Can you remove this dish from the bill?
I would prefer to cancel this dish.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Excusez-moi. Mon plat principal n’est pas arrivé.
reader.en: Excuse me. My main course has not arrived.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Je suis désolé. Je vais vérifier votre commande.
reader.en: I am sorry. I will check your order.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Les autres ont déjà terminé, et cela fait longtemps que j’attends.
reader.en: The others have already finished, and I have been waiting a long time.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: La cuisine l’a oublié. Le plat peut arriver dans quinze minutes.
reader.en: The kitchen forgot it. The dish can arrive in fifteen minutes.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci, mais je dois partir bientôt. Je préférerais annuler ce plat.
reader.en: Thank you, but I have to leave soon. I would prefer to cancel this dish.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Je le retire de l’addition.
reader.en: Of course. I will remove it from the bill.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pouvez-vous m’apporter l’addition corrigée ?
reader.en: Can you bring me the corrected bill?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui. Voici l’addition sans le plat manquant.
reader.en: Yes. Here is the bill without the missing dish.

speaking.opening: Excusez-moi. Mon plat principal n’est pas arrivé.
speaking.goal: Explain that the meal never came and others have finished, ask the server to check, then request cancellation and a corrected bill.
wordBank: Pouvez-vous retirer ce plat de l’addition ?

see.cueEnglish: Find the phrase for a missing dish.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall how to say the others have finished.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the request to check the order.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for the bill.

say.cueEnglish: Tell the server your main course has not arrived.

write.cueEnglish: Write a polite request to remove the dish from the bill.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The service delay and bill resolution are fictional scene facts; review register and naturalness without presenting a universal entitlement.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: ask to split by person or item and handle cash and card
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Four travelers need two separate card payments and one cash payment.
lessons.title: Make Three Payments for Four Travelers
lessons.objective: Ask to divide a four-person bill by person or item, then make two card payments and one cash payment.
lessons.focus: Use partager l’addition, payer séparément, par personne/par plat, par carte and en espèces to state exactly who pays what.
lessons.scene: Four travelers have a sixty-euro lunch bill and need two individual card payments plus one shared cash payment.

cards.fr: Deux paiements par carte et un en espèces.
cards.en: Two card payments and one cash payment.

cards.fr: Maya règle quinze euros par carte.
cards.en: Maya pays fifteen euros by card.

cards.fr: Léa règle quinze euros par carte.
cards.en: Léa pays fifteen euros by card.

cards.fr: Sam et Noor règlent trente euros en espèces.
cards.en: Sam and Noor pay thirty euros in cash.

cards.fr: Le total est de soixante euros.
Vous pouvez répartir l’addition par personne ?
cards.en: Can you divide the bill per person?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Excusez-moi. Le total est de soixante euros, c’est bien ça ?
reader.en: Excuse me. The total is sixty euros, is that right?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, pour quatre personnes. Vous payez ensemble ?
reader.en: Yes, for four people. Are you paying together?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: On peut payer séparément ?
reader.en: Can we pay separately?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui. Vous voulez répartir par personne ou par plat ?
reader.en: Yes. Do you want to divide it per person or by dish?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Par personne. Nous ferons deux paiements par carte et un en espèces.
reader.en: Per person. We will make two card payments and one cash payment.

reader.speaker: Léa
reader.fr: Maya et moi réglons chacune quinze euros par carte.
reader.en: Maya and I each pay fifteen euros by card.

reader.speaker: Sam
reader.fr: Noor et moi réglons ensemble trente euros en espèces.
reader.en: Noor and I together pay thirty euros in cash.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Parfait : quinze, quinze et trente. Cela fait soixante euros.
reader.en: Perfect: fifteen, fifteen and thirty. That makes sixty euros.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. Voici ma carte pour le premier paiement.
reader.en: Thank you. Here is my card for the first payment.

speaking.goal: Confirm the sixty-euro total, split it equally among four travelers, make two fifteen-euro card payments and one thirty-euro cash payment for the other two travelers.
speaking.closure: Merci, les trois paiements font bien soixante euros.
wordBank: Deux paiements par carte et un en espèces.
Maya règle quinze euros par carte.
Léa règle quinze euros par carte.
Sam et Noor règlent trente euros en espèces.
Le total est de soixante euros.
Vous pouvez répartir l’addition par personne ?

see.cueEnglish: Find the phrase for paying separately.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the term for paying in cash.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the proposed mix of payments.

type.cueEnglish: Type the expression for the total.

say.cueEnglish: Ask the server to divide the bill per person.

write.cueEnglish: Write that Sam and Noor pay thirty euros in cash.

lessons.internalReviewNote: The sixty-euro total and payment handling are fictional. Review that spoken arithmetic and each payment group remain internally consistent.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: describe what made a dish exceptional and ask staff to pass on thanks
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Tell the chef the meal was extraordinary and explain the flavor or memory it created.
lessons.title: Praise the Cook with a Specific Detail
lessons.objective: Explain what made a lunch dish memorable and ask the server to pass your thanks to the cook.
lessons.focus: Use la cuisson, les herbes, le goût, cela me rappelle and transmettre mes compliments to give precise praise.
lessons.scene: After a memorable vegetable dish, Maya gives specific thanks to the server and asks that the cook hear them.

cards.fr: Le basilic donnait beaucoup de goût.
cards.en: The basil added a lot of flavor.

cards.fr: Cela me rappelle les déjeuners chez ma grand-mère.
cards.en: It reminds me of lunches at my grandmother’s home.

cards.fr: Pouvez-vous transmettre mes compliments à la cheffe ?
cards.en: Can you pass my compliments to the chef?

cards.fr: Je la remercie pour ce repas.
cards.en: I thank her for this meal.

cards.fr: C’est le plat dont je me souviendrai.
cards.en: This is the dish I will remember.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Excusez-moi. Ce plat était extraordinaire.
reader.en: Excuse me. This dish was extraordinary.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Je suis ravi que vous l’ayez aimé. Qu’est-ce qui vous a plu ?
reader.en: I am glad you liked it. What did you enjoy?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Les légumes étaient parfaitement cuits, et le basilic donnait beaucoup de goût.
reader.en: The vegetables were perfectly cooked, and the basil added a lot of flavor.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: La cheffe choisit ses herbes chaque matin.
reader.en: The chef chooses her herbs each morning.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Ce goût me rappelle les déjeuners chez ma grand-mère.
reader.en: That flavor reminds me of lunches at my grandmother’s home.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: C’est un beau souvenir.
reader.en: That is a lovely memory.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Pouvez-vous transmettre mes compliments à la cheffe ?
reader.en: Can you pass my compliments to the chef?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Bien sûr. Je lui dirai ce que vous avez aimé.
reader.en: Of course. I will tell her what you liked.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Merci. C’est le plat dont je me souviendrai.
reader.en: Thank you. This is the dish I will remember.

speaking.goal: Praise the cooking and basil, explain the memory the dish evoked, and ask the server to pass your thanks to the chef.
speaking.closure: Merci de transmettre mes compliments à la cheffe.
wordBank: Le basilic donnait beaucoup de goût.
Cela me rappelle les déjeuners chez ma grand-mère.
Pouvez-vous transmettre mes compliments à la cheffe ?
Je la remercie pour ce repas.
C’est le plat dont je me souviendrai.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French word for basil.

recall.cueEnglish: Recall the phrase for a memorable dish.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the request to pass compliments to the chef.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for flavor.

say.cueEnglish: Say what made the dish extraordinary.

write.cueEnglish: Write a request to pass compliments to the chef.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Review naturalness of la cheffe and advanced relative-clause phrase for this Core level; the server’s herb-sourcing remark is fictional.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: make a low-pressure invitation, agree on time and place, and accept either answer
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Invite a local acquaintance to lunch and choose a place together.
lessons.title: Invite a Local Acquaintance to Lunch
lessons.objective: Invite someone without pressure, accept an initial decline and agree on a different day, place and time.
lessons.focus: Use ça vous dirait de, si cela vous convient, aucun souci and une autre fois to offer and reschedule politely.
lessons.scene: Maya invites local acquaintance Camille to lunch; Camille cannot come tomorrow but can meet on Friday.

cards.fr: Ça vous dirait de déjeuner ensemble ?
cards.en: Would you like to have lunch together?

cards.fr: Si ça ne vous arrange pas, aucun souci.
cards.en: If that does not work for you, no problem.

cards.fr: Retrouvons-nous à midi devant le bistrot.
cards.en: Let’s meet at noon outside the bistro.

cards.fr: Je connais un petit bistrot près du marché.
cards.en: I know a small bistro near the market.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Camille, ça vous dirait de déjeuner ensemble demain ?
reader.en: Camille, would you like to have lunch together tomorrow?

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Merci pour l’invitation, mais demain je ne peux pas.
reader.en: Thank you for the invitation, but I cannot tomorrow.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Aucun souci. Une autre fois, si ça vous convient.
reader.en: No problem. Another time, if that works for you.

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Vendredi, je serais libre à midi.
reader.en: On Friday, I would be free at noon.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Vendredi, ça me va. Je connais un petit bistrot près du marché.
reader.en: Friday works for me. I know a small bistro near the market.

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Bonne idée. Il est facile à trouver ?
reader.en: Good idea. Is it easy to find?

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Oui. Retrouvons-nous à midi devant le bistrot.
reader.en: Yes. Let’s meet at noon outside the bistro.

reader.speaker: Camille
reader.fr: Parfait, à vendredi !
reader.en: Great, see you Friday!

speaking.opening: Camille, ça vous dirait de déjeuner ensemble demain ?
speaking.goal: Invite Camille, accept a declined first date without pressure, agree on Friday noon and confirm the bistro meeting point.
speaking.closure: Parfait, à vendredi devant le bistrot.
wordBank: Ça vous dirait de déjeuner ensemble ?
Si ça ne vous arrange pas, aucun souci.
Retrouvons-nous à midi devant le bistrot.

see.cueEnglish: Find the French phrase for another time.

hear.cueEnglish: Listen for the reply declining tomorrow.

type.cueEnglish: Type the French word for Friday.

write.cueEnglish: Write the agreed meeting time and place.

lessons.internalReviewNote: Review consistent vous-register between acquaintances and whether the alternative day and meeting point are clear.

lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: combine choosing a place, ordering, a dietary question, a correction, and splitting the bill from lessons 1–14
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Run an ordinary weekday lunch with a friend from finding a table to splitting the bill, fixing one small problem along the way.
lessons.title: Run a Weekday Lunch from Start to Finish
lessons.objective: Choose a place, check an ingredient, place lunch orders, correct a missing item and split the final bill.
lessons.focus: Recycle place choice, order confirmation, ingredient questions, il manque, and payer séparément in one connected conversation.
lessons.scene: Maya and Léa choose a nearby bistro, order lunch, fix a missing soup and pay separately.

cards.fr: Vous avez une table pour deux ?
cards.en: Do you have a table for two?

cards.fr: Je prends le plat du jour sans cette sauce.
cards.en: I will have the daily special without that sauce.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Le bistrot de quartier a l’air bien. Il faut attendre longtemps ?
reader.en: The neighborhood bistro looks good. Is there a long wait?

reader.speaker: Léa
reader.fr: Il n’y a presque personne. Entrons.
reader.en: There is hardly anyone. Let’s go in.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Bonjour. Vous avez une table pour deux ?
reader.en: Hello. Do you have a table for two?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, juste ici. Vous voulez le plat du jour ?
reader.en: Yes, right here. Would you like the daily special?

reader.speaker: Léa
reader.fr: La sauce contient des cacahuètes ?
reader.en: Does the sauce contain peanuts?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, la sauce en contient.
reader.en: Yes, the sauce contains them.

reader.speaker: Léa
reader.fr: Alors, je prends le plat du jour sans cette sauce.
reader.en: Then I will have the daily special without that sauce.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Et moi, je prends une soupe et le plat du jour.
reader.en: And I will have a soup and the daily special.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Très bien. Je vous apporte les deux plats et la soupe.
reader.en: Very good. I will bring you the two main courses and the soup.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Excusez-moi, il manque ma soupe. Pouvez-vous vérifier notre commande ?
reader.en: Excuse me, my soup is missing. Can you check our order?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, je l’apporte tout de suite.
reader.en: Yes, I will bring it right away.

reader.speaker: Léa
reader.fr: Merci. À la fin, on pourra payer séparément ?
reader.en: Thank you. At the end, can we pay separately?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, je peux faire deux paiements.
reader.en: Yes, I can take two payments.

reader.speaker: Maya
reader.fr: Parfait. Apportez-nous l’addition après la soupe, s’il vous plaît.
reader.en: Perfect. Bring us the bill after the soup, please.

speaking.role: Guest managing a lunch with a friend
speaking.opening: Bonjour. Vous avez une table pour deux ?
speaking.goal: Choose the bistro and table, ask about peanuts in the sauce, place both orders, correct the missing soup and split the bill.

Je prends le plat du jour sans cette sauce.
